description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/central_D2y_6_periodic. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=4, NY=8 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the compound D(D(u,y),y) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior 7-point sixth-order stencil aggregate plus the six one-sided sixth-order periodic face lines over the full other-axis strips no wall free names (periodic wrap)), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
